name: n019_source_reconstruction_diag_20261112
purpose: Diagnostic only: determine whether residual source-speaker information in the Unit HiFi-GAN/units causes the E-VPC S gap. This is not a proposed anonymisation method and cannot replace DU-pred-nt.

speaker_embedding_extraction.name: n019_source_nt_diag
speaker_embedding_extraction.method: Source-speaker W-PRO means using at most 32 utterances per speaker.
speaker_embedding_extraction.stop_condition: Stop after verified 250-D finite unit-norm test and LS360 speaker embeddings, or fail on missing data/DCU error/non-finite embeddings.
speaker_embedding_extraction.failure: The d7 home does not contain the original LibriSpeech train-clean-360 FLAC corpus. Test embeddings for 40 speakers completed before the failure.

full_s_diagnostic.name: n019_source_s_diag
input: source-reconstruction target maps for 1,934 test utterances and 104,014 LS360 utterances
full_s_diagnostic.protocol: Same official VPC2024 post-evaluation S path, duration mode pred, UTMOS/WhiSQA/WER unchanged.
full_s_diagnostic.stop_condition: Stop after a verified six-row results_anon.txt and s_metrics.json, or on shm/OOM/node failure, or at the four-hour wall limit.

ls360_embedding_extraction_d5_ai.name: n019_source_nt_ls360_20261112_171202
ls360_embedding_extraction_d5_ai.stop_condition: Stop after 921 finite unit-norm 250-D speaker means and a verified SHA256, or fail on source/W-PRO/DCU error, or at the one-hour outer limit.
ls360_embedding_extraction_d5_ai.failure: The d5 code tree lacked scripts/gpu_tiny_matmul_watchdog.sh; the job exited before watchdog/model/audio work.

ls360_embedding_extraction_d7.name: n019_source_nt_ls360
ls360_embedding_extraction_d7.reason: d7 can read d5 raw FLAC, so extraction stays on d7 HPC without cross-account AI container complications.
ls360_embedding_extraction_d7.stop_condition: Stop after 921 finite unit-norm 250-D speaker means and a verified SHA256, or fail on source/W-PRO/DCU error, or at the one-hour wall limit.
ls360_embedding_extraction_d7.verification: 921 keys, 250-D, finite, unit norm, exact map-key match

interpretation_gate.if_source_s_remains_near_31: The residual gap is in the vocoder/unit training recipe rather than target sampling or target pooling.
interpretation_gate.if_source_s_falls_materially_below_31: Random target conditioning is removing a large source-speaker component; audit target embedding representation and conditioning strength.
interpretation_gate.formal_use: Never report this diagnostic as a paper method or use it as a formal DU-pred-nt result.
